all.name: Bruce Banner
all.description: Brilliant scientist Dr. Bruce Banner has finally found a way to coexist with his monstrous alter ego, the Hulk. By accumulating gamma energy over transformations, he can become a wise and strong Hero Hulk or a fierce and destructive Monster Hulk – a true force of fury on the battlefield!

item.name: Gamma Ray Gun
item.description: Fire with a Gamma Ray Gun.

item.name: Heavy Blow
item.description: Swing fists forward to punch enemies.

item.name: Heavy Blow
item.description: Swing fists forward to punch and <Debuff>launch up</> enemies.

item.name: Gamma Grenade
item.description: Launch a Gamma Grenade to inflict damage and <Debuff>Launch Up</> enemies.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact
additional_fields.Special_Effect: When the caster enters the spell field, it restores 50 gamma energy

item.name: Gamma Burst
item.description: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce <Orange>Indestructible Guard</> cooldown upon hit.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile that can pierce through enemies
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Each direct hit reduces Indestructible Guard cooldown by 1s

item.name: Gamma Burst
item.description: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce <Orange>Indestructible Guard</> cooldown upon hit.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile that can pierce through enemies
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Each direct hit reduces Indestructible Guard cooldown by 1s

item.name: Puny Banner
item.description: Transform from Bruce Banner into Hero Hulk.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: The caster is immobilized during the transformation process and gains Invincibility

item.name: Hulk Smash!
item.description: Unleash stored gamma energy, transforming from Hero Hulk into Monster Hulk for a limited time period. Gain immunity to <Debuff>Launch</> and <Debuff>Knockback</> effects.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: The caster is immobilized during the transformation process and gains Invincibility

item.name: Indestructible Guard
item.description: Generate gamma shields for Hero Hulk and nearby allies, absorbing and converting damage into energy for <Orange>HULK SMASH!</>

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster
additional_fields.Special_Effect: When the caster's shield takes damage, 100% of the damage is converted into gamma energy. When an ally's shield takes damage, 10% of the damage is converted into gamma energy

item.name: Radioactive Lockdown
item.description: Emit gamma energy to render enemies immobilized and immune to all ability effects. Using <Orange>Heavy Blow</> or <Orange>Gamma Burst</> will prematurely remove this status.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Heavy Blow and Gamma Burst can detect and damage irradiated enemies, and prematurely remove the status

item.name: Radioactive Lockdown
item.description: Emit gamma energy to render enemies immobilized and immune to all ability effects. Using <Orange>Heavy Blow</> or <Orange>Gamma Burst</> will prematurely remove this status.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Heavy Blow and Gamma Burst can detect and damage irradiated enemies, and prematurely remove the status

item.name: World Breaker
item.description: Grab and smash the enemy in front.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: While performing the smash, Hulk gains a 30% Damage Reduction

item.name: Savage Toss
item.description: Press {Interactive} to grab a large broken object; press {PrimaryAttack} to fling it forward.

item.name: Brute Strength
item.description: Press {Interactive} to pick up a shield-like broken object and deploy a frontal shield; press {PrimaryAttack} to fling it forward.

item.name: Incredible Leap
item.description: Hold {Jump} to perform a charged leap that allows Hero Hulk to <Debuff>Knock Down</> flying enemies.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Press Space during the Incredible Leap to cling to the wall you encounter

item.name: Incredible Leap
item.description: Hold {Jump} to perform a charged leap that allows Monster Hulk to <Debuff>Knock Down</> flying enemies.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Press Space during the Incredible Leap to cling to the wall you encounter
